PM Modi Highlights 'Self-Reliant India' in Mann Ki Baat Address

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nation in his monthly 'Mann Ki Baat' radio program. During the broadcast, he emphasized India's self-reliance and security capabilities, stating that the nation is secure and self-sufficient from 'sea to sky'. The program focused on showcasing the country's strengths and achievements.
